quotes.author: Albert Mayfield
quotes.text: Hi Captain Steve, thank you so much for the Sturgeon trip Dec 3, 2022, good time was had by all and to top it off we caught fish. Captain Charles and the rest. of the crew are top notched working with us newbie’s in bringing in the fish. This is the fourth trip I’ve taken with you and your crew and have always enjoyed. looking forward to going out with you again.

quotes.author: Forrest and Brittany
quotes.text: We went with a group of six for a full day with Captain Steve and deck hand Justin so we were in good company! These guys are experts. The bite started a little late and Captain Steve was kind enough to extend the time on the water and the results came with some good sturgeon!!!! And even a double hook up! Captain Steve cooked us some moose burgers and had snacks and coffee ready to go! Captain Steve and Justin are very nice people. Played good music, relaxed and overall an exceptional time spent fishing! If you’re even thinking about this trip, book it now!!!

quotes.author: David D.
quotes.text: Chartered halibut trip for youngest sons bachelor weekend, (1st time…(Fishing with flash, and marriage) and boy-O-boy did they deliver! Not only did Captn. Steve and crew help keep the atmosphere as one to remember, but their knowledge and expertise helped to delivered memories that will last a life time. The halibut haul will last for many months of glorious fish fries. If you have never experienced Bay fishing before, look to no one else but Flash Fishing and Captn. Steve. He’ll make ya famous! Thanks again for everything & we’ll see ya again real soon!

quotes.author: Frank orienti
quotes.text: I went on a half day trip for Halibut and had a Blast! I caught the fish of a lifetime with Captian Charles and Ben, I got a 40 inch striped bass! YES 40 inches and it Blew my mind away at how the caption had us on fish the whole time. These guy work VERY Hard for our enjoyment and do the BEST job! I’ve been on other boats and it just wasn’t as fun as this one. Ben is So cool, I really like him he’s really cool, and caption Charles was Super cool too! This will be the company I stick with for Sure! That’s for the Best time fishing!

quotes.author: Matt Macomber
quotes.text: Captain Charles and deck hand Ben were amazing! They got us on the fish and worked hard for us. They worked together well, communicating with each other about locations and strategies, and kept us in the loop the whole time. Ben, was a machine on deck. He watched over us like a mother hen making sure we did it right. Going rod to rod helping us make minor adjustments. In the end, we had 4 limits of halibut and striper in 3 hours. Great team work and service. We’ll be back! Thanks fellas!

Capt Dave and Mario took us out on a foggy morning for shark fishing. They put us on the fish at the 1st spot . Then found a second spot and we caught so many shark. Mario gave us safety talk before heading out and Dave filled us with great stories all day. Clean boat skilled professionals.

Captain Charles and our deck hand (Lucas?) were absolutely amazing! It was our first time ocean fishing and we were so glad we did it! Our 5yo chose to do this for his birthday and he was THRILLED being able to catch these big fish and be a helper for the deck hand. The crew was very patient with the kiddos wanting to be right there for it all. I will recommend these guys for anyone wanting to charter a boat and have an amazing experience. We will definitely be back in the future. Thank you flash fishing!!

Captain Steve and Deck Hand John made our experience one to remember! They were kind, full of knowledge and funny! We had sharks biting within minutes of stopping and continued that way through the duration of our trip. We caught many leopard and sand sharks. The half day trip went by so quickly we all wished we would have booked the full day. The entire family had a great time! Captain Steve and John were great with our boys! Highly recommend and will be back if we are ever in the area again!
